MSME Transformation
An ambitious growth and transformation project supported by International Finance Corporation. We seek to be the foremost
SME Bank in Kenya.
 Clearly defined MSME segments
 The key pillars are: Credit Scoring, SCF- Supply Chain Financing, CVP- Customer Value Proposition Model, Segmentation,
Credit Process Review, Product Offering Review and Non Financial Service (NFS) offering
 14 initiatives under pilot in 7 branches
 Branch champions undergoing experiential training to facilitate roll-out
 Supply chain finance- under pilot, has gained great traction in the market ( over 90 suppliers on board)
Shared Services & Digitization ‘The Digital Bank’
 Digital transformation of processes and customer journeys is ongoing;
 Omni Channel Implementation for prioritized segments; Corporate, MSME, Diaspora and Millennial Banking
 A dedicated project team to support all Bank prioritized Customer Journeys has been set up.
 A sandbox team- Formed to run specific customer journeys and end to end Digitization
 Aimed at operational efficiency
 Digital Bank transformation strategy has been firmed up.
NPL management and Credit Processes (NPL 2.0)
 Proactively reducing default risk
 Continuously improving credit processes
 Implementation of IFRS 9 requirements is on track
 Growing credit offering through digital channels
